name: Paris Paloma
description: '''Paris Paloma''' (born 17 November 1999) is a British singer-songwriter and guitarist. She gained prominence through the single "[[Labour (song)|Labour]]" (2023). Her debut album, ''[[Cacophony (Paris Paloma album)|Cacophony]]'', was released in 2024. Her second album, ''[[The Fatal Flaw]]'', followed in 2026.
